title: The Bridge That Waited: A Lecture on Infrastructure Trade-offs
instructions: 本材料为模拟教学练习，非官方雅思试题。听录音前先读题；录音中说话者会自然修正和插话，注意区分事实与干扰信息。语法部分先看中文讲解，再做8道新题。所有题目答案均来自原文，填空答案必须与原文完全一致。
transcript: LECTURER: Good morning. Today we look at a small bridge project. It is a simulated case, not a real place. The town of Riverton wanted a new footbridge over the river. Two plans were discussed. Plan A was cheaper. Plan B was stronger. The council chose Plan B. Why? Because the river floods every spring. A weak bridge would be closed for weeks. So the stronger design was selected. The extra cost was about two million. That money came from the regional budget. Now, a trade-off means you gain one thing and lose another. Here, the town gained safety but lost some parkland. Three old trees were removed. Some residents were unhappy. They said the trees were important. The council agreed to plant ten new trees nearby. Those trees will grow slowly. So the benefit is delayed. MAYA: Excuse me, was the public consulted? LECTURER: Yes, two meetings were held. But only forty people came. MAYA: So most people were not heard. LECTURER: That is a fair point. The process was criticized for that reason. Now, look at the timeline. The design was finished in March. Construction started in June. The bridge was opened in December. It was used by 800 people on the first day. That number was higher than expected. The old ferry was closed afterwards. Some ferry workers were retrained. Others were let go. This is another trade-off. Jobs were lost, but travel time was cut. Before, the crossing took twenty minutes. Now it takes four minutes. The saved time helps local shops. Deliveries are faster. However, the bridge is not perfect. It was built for walkers and cyclists only. Cars cannot use it. So drivers still use the old road bridge. That bridge is often crowded. A wider road bridge was proposed, but it was rejected. The cost was too high. So the problem was only partly solved. Let me finish with a question. When you read about infrastructure, ask: who gains, who loses, and who decides? These three questions are useful. They are not always easy to answer. But they help you read critically. Next week we will look at a water project. Please read the short case before class. Thank you.

grammar.title: 被动语态；因果表达；分词作定语的基础辨认
grammar.explanation: 本课重点是被动语态：当句子强调“动作承受者”而不是“谁做的”时，用 be + 过去分词。例如原文 'The bridge was opened in December.' 中，bridge 是“被开放”的对象，所以用 was opened。因果表达常用 because, so, for that reason 等连接原因和结果。分词作定语是用分词放在名词前或后修饰名词，如 'the saved time'（被节省的时间）中 saved 是过去分词作前置定语；'A wider road bridge was proposed' 中 proposed 是被动结构 was proposed 的一部分，不是定语。注意区分：本课新学“被动语态+因果表达+分词作定语辨认”，复习一般现在时主动句和一般过去时主动句。做题时先找主语和动词，判断主语是“做动作”还是“承受动作”。
grammar.example: The bridge was opened in December.

options: The new library was built last year.
The new library built last year.
The new library is build last year.
The new library were built last year.
answers: The new library was built last year.
questions.explanation: 被动语态结构为 be + 过去分词；library 是单数，过去时用 was built。
questions.evidence: The bridge was opened in December.

options: The trees were removed by workers.
The trees was removed by workers.
The trees are remove by workers.
answers: The trees were removed by workers.
questions.explanation: trees 是复数，过去被动用 were + 过去分词 removed。

options: The report was written by Maya.
The report were written by Maya.
The report is wrote by Maya.
answers: The report was written by Maya.
questions.explanation: report 是单数，过去被动用 was written。
questions.evidence: The design was finished in March.

options: The workers were retrained last month.
The workers was retrained last month.
The workers retrained last month by the company.
The workers are retrain last month.
answers: The workers were retrained last month.
questions.explanation: workers 是复数，过去被动用 were retrained。

options: The plan was rejected because the cost was too high.
The plan was rejected so the cost was too high.
The plan rejected because the cost was too high.
The plan was reject because the cost was too high.
answers: The plan was rejected because the cost was too high.
questions.explanation: 被动语态 was rejected；because 引导原因，符合因果表达。

questions.explanation: proposed 是过去分词作前置定语，放在名词 bridge 前，表示“被提议的桥”。
